# Arena asset credits

Every shipped file, its source, author and licence. Changes: rescaled to metres, merged per material, decimated (meshoptimizer), vertex colours regraded (Polyfork), textures resized/colour-graded and re-encoded as WebP, meshes meshopt-compressed.

## Procedural geometry

All other prefabs (barn parts, doors, silo, warehouse, roller door, containers, feeding tower, fence, gate, gatehouse, jetty/boardwalk, culvert, ruins, drums, pallet, lamp, sign, hay, boulders, bluff blocks) are generated at runtime by src/view/arenaassets.js (project code, no third-party geometry).

## Ideas adapted (no code copied)

The near-grass shading (blade translucency toward the bright sky, per-blade self-shadowing at the root, patchy thinning, trampling by world-space feet) follows the ideas in https://github.com/cortiz2894/stylized-components by Christian Ortiz (MIT License), re-implemented as three.js TSL node code in src/view/world.js.
